feedback.SCR-10:o2: Availability would lag behind reality, and indexing cannot perform the hold. Live retrieval suits data where minutes-to-hours freshness dominates.
feedback.SCR-10:o3: Web history makes page titles from a user's own browsing searchable. It returns no current availability and performs no action.
feedback.SCR-10:o1: Right. Freshness dominates and a write is required. Tools retrieve current data or perform actions at request time; an index is a snapshot and cannot place a hold.
feedback.SCR-14:o2: This duplicates a supported connector and moves support to you. Native and custom connectors use separate namespaces, so filters and agents scoped to one do not see the other.
feedback.SCR-14:o1: Right. Use an existing connector before building a new one. Custom Metadata attaches to documents from any datasource, including native connectors, without re-indexing.
feedback.SCR-14:o3: This pushes a data-model problem onto users and still creates no filterable field.
